fit_gaps: Exact aperture, stroke, voltage, software and certification configuration remains to be quoted.
anchor.localisation: Buy the first fleet cassettes and controls; localise portal, threshold, harness and service parts first; replace the cassette only after EN 14752-equivalent validation.
anchor.product_family: IFE modular entrance systems

fit_gaps: Curvature, heater power, optical zones, laminate stack and frame/bond geometry remain project-specific.
anchor.localisation: Local glass processors may replace AGC after laminate, heater, optical, edge, fire, impact and bond-system qualification against the frozen cassette drawing.
anchor.product_family: rail glazing with framing system

fit_gaps: Public material does not freeze the LM3 24 kW duty, rail evidence or roof envelope.
anchor.localisation: Keep the released 800 V-class input, thermal duty, refrigerant, drains, duct and CAN/Ethernet interface; source local coils, ducts and service parts after performance testing.
anchor.product_family: direct-DC rail HVAC platform

fit_gaps: Select an exact module and rail-compatible clamp/bond stack after the roof curvature and electrical string are frozen.
anchor.localisation: Equivalent local modules are acceptable after roof fire, isolation, vibration, hail/impact, walk-zone and bonded/clamped retention tests.
anchor.product_family: eArc lightweight photovoltaic modules

fit_gaps: Structural board selection and the final covering/adhesive combination remain to be frozen.
anchor.localisation: Use the supplier system for first articles; qualify local board/covering as a complete substrate, adhesive, weld, cove, hatch and fire-tested system rather than swapping one layer.
anchor.product_family: Transport Flooring rail systems

fit_gaps: Exact seat model, upholstery, spacing, handrail geometry and calculated attachment loads remain open.
anchor.localisation: The OSR common rail and adapters are local; seat shells, frames and handrails may be locally made after fire, abuse-load, sharp-edge, corrosion and accessibility validation.
anchor.product_family: Metro and urban rail passenger seating

fit_gaps: Exact display, camera, amplifier, intercom, recorder and software licences remain to be selected.
anchor.localisation: Use open Ethernet/IP interfaces and OSR mounting adapters so displays, cameras, audio and intercoms can be substituted individually after EMC, cybersecurity, accessibility and system regression tests.
anchor.product_family: rail passenger information, video and communication systems

fit_gaps: Exact lamp models, optics, voltage variants and emergency battery arrangement remain open.
anchor.localisation: Local luminaires are acceptable at the standard plug and mounting cassette after photometry, glare, fire, EMC, IP, emergency-duration and temperature tests.
anchor.product_family: rail interior, emergency and exterior lighting

fit_gaps: Exact grip range, head, thread, material and setting force must be selected from each released joint drawing.
anchor.localisation: Equivalent inserts and captive hardware are allowed only by joint family after substrate-specific setting trials, proof loads, corrosion and removal-cycle tests.
anchor.product_family: RIVNUT blind rivet nuts and setting systems

fit_gaps: No public product family alone establishes the complete LM3 rail fire/structural laminate; formulation and process qualification remain open.
anchor.localisation: Resin, reinforcement, core and coating may be sourced locally only as a qualified laminate system with coupon, fire, weathering, insert and full-module evidence.
anchor.product_family: fire-retardant composite laminating and core materials

fit_gaps: The current HM47-class planning envelope is not an ABB order code; ABB must confirm a 250 kW continuous / 350 kW short-peak, 800 V-compatible configuration and mass envelope.
anchor.localisation: Buy the initial motor; local rewind, bearings and eventually a locally manufactured equivalent require the frozen torque-speed, cooling, insulation, shaft, foot, mass and EMC interfaces plus type tests.
anchor.product_family: AMXM railway traction motor

fit_gaps: Ratio, centre distance, torque, coupling, reaction-link and lubrication configuration remain to be quoted.
anchor.localisation: Local housings/gears may replace the anchor only after tooth, bearing, lubrication, fatigue, efficiency, noise, overspeed and endurance qualification with the frozen motor/wheelset interfaces.
anchor.product_family: SE-type single-stage axle-mounted metro gear unit and gear coupling

fit_gaps: The ABB platform is a rail-qualified architecture anchor, not proof that one published configuration meets the LM3 800 V LFP, 225 kWh/car, side-pin charging, packaging or price targets.
anchor.localisation: Treat each converter, battery, charger/contact system and protection panel as separable behind frozen DC-link, cooling, HVIL, network and mechanical interfaces; qualify lower-cost local modules one at a time.
anchor.product_family: BORDLINE CC400/ESC/PB and Traction Battery Pro reference platform

fit_gaps: Battery chemistry, enclosure, detection thresholds, nozzle layout, reservoir and control integration remain project-specific.
anchor.localisation: Local detectors, pipework, reservoir and pumps may be introduced only within a vehicle fire-hazard analysis and propagation-tested suppression/detection system.
anchor.product_family: rail fire detection and high-pressure water-mist systems

fit_gaps: Wheel profile, diameter, axle journal, disc seats, material grades and load spectrum remain to be frozen.
anchor.localisation: Local wheel/axle manufacture is encouraged only after metallurgy, forging, heat treatment, NDT, press-fit, profile, fatigue and route-specific standards are qualified and independently accepted.
anchor.product_family: urban-rail wheelsets

fit_gaps: Bearing size, journal fit, housing, grounding, speed/temperature sensor and cable interfaces remain to be frozen.
anchor.localisation: Local housings and sensor brackets may be made to the supplier-controlled bearing unit; an alternative bearing unit needs L10/load, fit, seal, grease, thermal, shock and field-monitoring evidence.
anchor.product_family: ready-to-mount railway axlebox bearing units with sensors

fit_gaps: Continental anchors spring systems; centre pivot, yaw-link and damper suppliers still require project RFQ and a common body-to-bogie interface control drawing.
anchor.localisation: Springs, bushes and dampers may be sourced regionally after the multibody model, load-deflection/damping curves, compound ageing, fatigue and ride tests are repeated; pivot/anti-lift hardware stays separately calculated.
anchor.product_family: rail primary suspension and secondary air-spring systems

fit_gaps: The LM3 brake concept needs supplier confirmation of actuation energy, caliper variant, disc/pad pair, parking brake and whether the suspension-only compressor can support the selected brake architecture.
anchor.localisation: Pads, discs, hoses and overhaul parts can localise first under brake-supplier approval; caliper/actuator or compressor substitutes require stopping, parking, thermal, WSP, degraded-mode and endurance revalidation.
anchor.product_family: WheelAct/AxleAct rail brake actuation and PistonSupply/DrySupply air supply

fit_gaps: The published 600/500 kN family is an anchor; height, articulation, fold, electrical head, crash stroke and OSR pocket loads remain to be frozen.
anchor.localisation: Local pocket, covers and harness may be manufactured to the Dellner interface; another coupler requires buff/draft, crash, rescue, gathering range, electrical head and fatigue compatibility evidence.
anchor.product_family: automatic coupler Type 430 with pivot anchor

fit_gaps: No catalogue bearing is selected until the articulation load spectrum, pin diameter, angular motion and safety factors are released.
anchor.localisation: Local housings, pins and links are preferred; bearing or rod-end substitution requires static/dynamic capacity, misalignment, liner, corrosion, temperature, sealing and fatigue equivalence.
anchor.product_family: ELGES maintenance-free spherical plain bearings and rod ends

fit_gaps: The vehicle-specific bellows, bridge, turntable, clamp and open-end drawbar geometry remains to be engineered with the supplier.
anchor.localisation: Bellows textile, panels and bridge pieces may localise after fire, fatigue, water, passenger load, pinch-gap and full-motion testing to the frozen clamp frames.
anchor.product_family: modular metro/urban-rail gangway systems

fit_gaps: The final carrier series, connector inserts, cable compounds, hose lengths and articulation sweep remain to be frozen.
anchor.localisation: Hoses and cables may be made locally to controlled drawings; carrier, connector or jacket substitutions require bend-cycle, separation, IP, fire, current, pressure, EMC and breakaway tests.
anchor.product_family: e-chain dynamic cable carriers with Han rail connectors

fit_gaps: Moxa anchors computing/network hardware only; the independent safety controller, navigation sensors, HMI and safety relays need exact part selection and safety allocation.
anchor.localisation: OSR software remains portable behind published I/O, TSN/Ethernet and update interfaces; alternate compute/network hardware must pass timing, safety allocation, EMC, environmental, cybersecurity and whole-train hardware-in-loop tests.
anchor.product_family: EN 50155 railway computers, Ethernet switches and wireless gateways

fit_gaps: Exact recorder family, protected memory, interfaces and national event-data requirements remain open.
anchor.localisation: Operational storage can be local commodity hardware; the protected recorder, data set, clock, crash/fire resistance and download chain require independently accepted railway evidence.
anchor.product_family: JRU/EVA event recording systems

fit_gaps: The commercial sensor is an envelope/data anchor, not railway obstacle-detection certification or a complete T-OBS function.
anchor.localisation: The nose carrier accepts alternative lidar/camera/radar modules after field of view, latency, heating/washer, ingress, EMC, failure-detection and complete obstacle-detection safety validation.
anchor.product_family: OS industrial digital lidar sensor family

purpose: Real supplier product families provide a purchasable/RFQ baseline and a reproducible interface target. They are anchors, not mandatory brands: a local equivalent is accepted only after the same controlled equivalence dossier passes.
release_boundary: A web page is not a purchase specification. Design authority must freeze the exact supplier part number, configuration, drawings, software, evidence, commercial terms and spares through RFQ before release. Safety-critical substitutes require calculation, test, independent assessment and authority acceptance.
